summary:
FOUNDATION for the "Danmaku native" settings rewrite (teal/coral recolour from the real icon). Everything shared is built; the 8 pages are placeholders for page agents.

FILES
- src/renderer/styles/tokens.css: design tokens (light + dark via prefers-color-scheme under :root:not([data-theme=light])). Accent is TEAL (light #0b7480 with white text 5.5:1; dark #3ccfd6 with --on-accent #04262b 8.4:1); --accent-hover/-text(6.1:1)/-soft/-soft-2/-ring, --focus. Brand deco --cyan/--cyan-bright (shapes only), CORAL --coral (deco), --coral-text (5.5:1), --coral-soft. Semantic ok=#18743a (true green, not confusable with teal), warn, bad=#c0262d (crimson), violet (summary). Neutrals slightly navy; --field-border (3.3:1, WCAG 1.4.11 input edges); --switch-off 3:1. Dark navy dock tokens in both themes (--dock, --dock-2, --dock-3, --dock-line, --dock-text, --dock-text-2 7.9:1, --dock-coral, --dock-cyan). Radii (--r-xs..--r-xl, --r-card 16, --r-stage, --r-callout, --r-pill), spacing --sp-1..--sp-14, type scale --fs-*, shadows, motion, sizes (--side-w 212/196 below 1060, --dock-h 72, --pad-x 28/22, --ctl-h 36/32).
- styles/base.css: reset, root font (overlay measures with it), tabular nums, hidden number spinners, scrollbars, :focus-visible ring, .sr-only, .spin, pulse-coral keyframes, forced-colors basics, reduced motion (transitions off globally; animations off per component, never the overlay scroll).
- styles/components.css: all component styles + forced-colors fallbacks (switch, slider, segmented, radio cards, meters, bars, tabs) + PAGE LAYOUT HELPERS: .stack, .split / .split.is-wide (+ .aside sticky), .row2, .row3, .divider, .sec-title, .sub-block, .kv, .chips.
- styles/shell.css: app grid, sidebar, profile popover, nav, page header, dock (play, state, countdown track: teal gradient; .is-delay coral stripes; .is-busy sweep; .is-empty), 「弹」 toggle, responsive (≤1060 hides 请求体 stat + save-state text; ≤980 hides stats), forced colors.
- styles/overlay.css: overlay rules moved verbatim (.overlay-root, .danmaku-line, keyframes, transparent overlay-view) and shared with `.danmaku-text` (same rule), plus .dm-stage (preview stage, container-relative fly animation, static under reduced motion), .dm-pill.
- styles/{overview,logs,model,danmaku,character,prompt,rhythm,capture}.css: empty placeholders, each already imported by its page file.
- src/renderer/assets/icon-64.png, icon-128.png (real icon; brand mark + loading/error screen).
- settings/SettingsApp.tsx: shell = Sidebar | main (PageHeader + .page-body with Banners + page) + Dock; hash routing (#overview default, unknown→overview), scrolls .page-body to top and sets document.title "<页> · 弹幕伴侣" on page change; loading screen; loadError (incl. BRIDGE_MISSING_MESSAGE) in a bad callout.
- settings/shell/: Sidebar.tsx (icon brand, ProfileSwitcher, nav groups 实时/设置, logs count Badge, dirty dots per page, red dot on 总览 when status.lastError, footer 配置与密钥只保存在本机), ProfileSwitcher.tsx (role="dialog" aria-modal=false popover: profile list with ✓/当前/MM-DD, rename form, 复制为新配置 form, 删除“name”…; focus moves to active profile on open; Escape/action returns focus to trigger; outside click / tab-out closes; spinner on the busy action), PageHeader.tsx (h1+description; dirty → 「有未保存的修改」 + 还原 + 保存 [Ctrl S kbd / ⌘S], busy 保存中; clean → quiet ✓ 已保存), Banners.tsx (actionError dismissible; status.lastError non-dismissible + 查看日志 → (hidden on #logs), adds 「循环仍在运行，下一轮会自动重试」 when running), Dock.tsx (play/pause 启动/暂停/处理中 + spinner; state dot + role=status + 第 N 轮; DockCountdown is the only ticking part: 下次截图 + 上次生成 HH:MM:SS · n 条 / 首次截图 + 启动延迟… (coral stripes) / 正在生成… (sweep, also while manual generate) / 未启动 or 下次截图 + 启动后 N 秒首次截图 (empty track); progressbar from nextCycleArmedAt→nextCycleAt; stats 耗时/缓存命中/请求体; 生成一次 (生成中); 「弹」 aria-pressed toggle; 清屏), useHashPage.ts.
- settings/useSettingsController.ts, useCountdown.ts, format.ts, dirty.ts, constants.ts, pages/types.ts, pages/*Page.tsx (8 placeholders), components/*.tsx + index.ts.
- src/renderer/previewData.ts + api.ts: ?demo=running|delay|paused|idle|error loads 3 profiles (默认配置 / 直播用（录屏可见） / 云端 GPT-4o), 3 models (one vision+loaded), demo config (batch-sliding, history images, historySummaryEnabled), 39 logs over the last hour (truncated, budget + 413 compactions with cache dips, error with historyRecovery reset, aborted, resizedToFit, 3 manual, 2 summaries). Running: live re-arming countdown (timer → 2.4 s "generating" → new log + overlay items → re-arm with min–max interval); start() arms the start delay (nextCycleIsFirst); stop() clears; generateOnce adds a manual log after 900 ms and emits palette-coloured overlay items. Without ?demo the mock is unchanged (window.location guarded for the existing test).
- App.tsx imports settings/SettingsApp; main.tsx imports tokens/base/components/overlay CSS first and adds overlay-view classes synchronously for ?view=overlay (no first-frame flash).
- src/electron/main/windowManager.ts: settings BrowserWindow backgroundColor = nativeTheme.shouldUseDarkColors ? #0f1319 : #f3f5f8 (token --bg); listens to nativeTheme "updated" → setBackgroundColor while the window exists; listener removed on "closed".
- Tests: test/settingsFormat.test.ts (countdownState incl. delay/fallback/generating, formatCountdown, byte/MB/cache formats, rangeHint, parseScaledInput/displayNumber, countText, logPill, logFlags, compactionLabel, latest*/series helpers, dirtyPages split, pageFromHash), test/previewData.test.ts (scenarios, data coverage, demo mock re-arming countdown with fake timers, start delay/stop).

PAGE CONTRACT: `export function XPage({ controller, navigate }: PageProps)` (pages/types.ts). navigate(pageId) for 查看日志 etc. Each page file already imports its CSS file. Use useCountdown/useNow only inside a small leaf component.

CONTROLLER — useSettingsController(): { loadError: string|null; controller: SettingsController|null }. SettingsController (all actions return Promise that never rejects; failures set actionError):
- config: AppConfig (saved); draft: AppConfig; dirty: boolean; dirtyPages: Record<'model'|'danmaku'|'character'|'prompt'|'rhythm'|'capture', boolean> (character = character+user; rhythm = interval*/startDelay/items*/releaseWindow*; capture = every other runtime field except enabled); saving; edit<K extends 'model'|'character'|'user'|'prompt'|'danmaku'|'runtime'>(section, patch: Partial<AppConfig[K]>); save() (also Ctrl/⌘+S, ignores IME composition); revert() (还原).
- profiles: ConfigProfilesSnapshot|null; activeProfile; profileWorking: 'create'|'rename'|'switch'|'delete'|null; profileBusy; switchProfile(id)/renameProfile(name)/createProfile(name)/deleteProfile() → Promise<boolean> (switch & create save draft first; delete confirms, never the last).
- status: RuntimeStatus; workingAction: 'generate'|'start'|'test'|null (one shared slot; disable run/generate/test buttons when non-null); toggleRunning() (start saves first); generateOnce() (saves first).
- overlayVisible; toggleOverlay(); clearOverlay().
- modelList; modelListLoading; modelOptions: ModelOption[]; selectedModel; modelListNote ("3 个模型 · loaded · 视觉" | error | "-"); modelListFailed; refreshModels() (saves first); connection: ConnectionTestResult|null; testConnection() (save → test → refresh list); dismissConnection().
- logs: GenerationLogEntry[] (newest first, reloaded on each status broadcast); logsLoading; refreshLogs(); clearLogs() (window.confirm first).
- isMac; openScreenRecordingSettings(); actionError; dismissActionError(); run(fn) (runAction for custom async work).
HOOKS: useNow(intervalMs=1000, active=true): number; useCountdown(status, intervalMs=250): CountdownState {phase:'countdown'|'delay'|'generating'|'stopped', remainingMs?, remainingSeconds? (ceil), totalMs?, elapsedFraction? 0–1}.

COMPONENTS (import from "../components"; controls inside <Field> take id/label/aria-describedby/aria-invalid from it automatically):
- Field {label, hint? (right: "10 – 96 px" via rangeHint), help?, error? (red, aria-invalid), tag?, group? (for RangePair/Segmented/RadioCards: label becomes aria-labelledby target), disabled?, id?, className?, children}. useFieldContext().
- Button {variant?: 'standard'|'primary'|'subtle'|'danger'|'dock', size?: 'md'|'sm', icon?, iconOnly? + label (aria-label+title), busy? (spinner, disabled, aria-busy), busyLabel?, block?, ...button attrs; type defaults "button"}. LinkButton {icon? trailing, ...button attrs} (underlined text action).
- Switch {checked, onChange(bool), label, description?, tag?, disabled?, hideLabel?, id?} — real checkbox role=switch, whole row clickable, switch on the left.
- NumberField {value, range (LIMITS.*), onCommit(n), step?=1 (display units), integer?, scale? (display = stored×scale: 100 for %, 0.001 for ms→秒), unit?, disabled?, id?/aria-*}.
- RangePair {min, max, range, onCommit({min,max}), step?, integer?, scale?, unit?, disabled?, minLabel?='最短', maxLabel?='最长', aria-label?} — warns when min>max, swaps on focus leave. Use in <Field group>.
- Stepper {value, range, onCommit, step?, unit? (shown after), disabled?, decrementLabel?, incrementLabel?}.
- SliderField {value, range, step (stored units), onCommit, scale?, unit?, integer?, disabled?, numberStep?, numberWidth?} — slider (gets Field id) + NumberField.
- TextField {value, onChange(string), type?: 'text'|'password'|'url'|'search' (password → eye reveal button), icon? (prefix), mono?, unit?, revealLabels?, inputRef?, ...input attrs}.
- TextArea {value, onChange, mono?, showCount? ("N 字 · M 行"), textareaRef?, rows?=4, ...textarea attrs}.
- Select {value, onChange(string), options?: {value,label,disabled?}[], placeholder? (adds value ""), mono?, children?}.
- ListField {values, parse(raw)→string[]|undefined (e.g. parsePalette, parseListInput), onCommit, placeholder?, disabled?, mono?, title?}.
- Segmented<T> {value, onChange, options: {value,label,icon?,count?,disabled?,title?}[], name?, full?, size?: 'md'|'sm', disabled?, aria-label?|aria-labelledby?} — real radios (arrow keys). ZoneIcon {zone}.
- RadioCards<T> {value, onChange, options: {value,title,description?,chip?,illustration?,disabled?}[], name?, aria-label?}.
- Card {title?, icon?, iconTone?: 'accent'|'coral'|'violet'|'ok'|'warn'|'bad'|'neutral', sub?, aside? (head right), footer?, level?: 2|3, bare? (no padded body grid), id?, className?, bodyClassName?, children}. TileIcon {icon, tone?, size?}.
- Callout {tone?: 'neutral'|'info'(accent tint)|'ok'|'warn'|'bad'|'violet', title? (bold lead-in), icon? | false, action?, onDismiss?, dismissLabel?, banner?, role? (default alert for bad, note otherwise; use "status" for results)}.
- Meter {value, max, label (aria), valueText?, tone?: accent|coral|ok|warn|bad|violet, mark? (0–1 tick), markLabel?, size?} role=meter, min 6 px fill.
- MiniBars {bars: {value?, tone?: accent|bad|warn|coral|ok|muted}[], max?, height?=22, label} role=img; undefined value → muted stub.
- Chip {tone?: neutral|accent|coral|ok|warn|bad|violet|outline, icon?, size?, title?}; Badge {tone?, label? (sr text)}; StatusPill {tone?: live(coral)|accent|ok|warn|bad|violet|neutral, dot?=true, pulse?}; TodoTag {hint} (「未实现」, hint as title + sr text); MacTag (「仅 macOS」); Swatch {color}.
- Tabs<T> {tabs: {id,label,badge?}[], value, onChange, idPrefix, aria-label} (roving tabindex, ←/→/Home/End) + TabPanel {idPrefix, id, children}.
- EmptyState {icon?, title, children?, action?, compact?}.
- DanmakuText {text, color?, fontSize?, opacity?, shadow?, fly?: {top, duration (s), delay?, x? (reduced-motion rest pos)}, as?, className?, style?} — exactly the overlay text style. DanmakuStage {backdrop?: 'night'|'document', height?=220, zone?: {top,bottom,label?} fractions, caption?, label (role=img name), children}. DanmakuPill {text, color?}.
- Decor (aria-hidden display:contents wrapper).

FORMAT/CONSTANTS: format.ts — statusLabels, logStatusLabels, logReasonLabels (自动/手动/后台), historyModeLabels (满额重置/分批滑动/逐轮滑动), zoneLabels, compactionTriggerLabels, historyRecoveryLabels/Tags, logPill(log)→{label,tone} (summary → violet 摘要), logFlags(log)→{key,label,tone,description}[] (缓存 x%, 输出截断, 压缩 −n 张 / 413 后压缩 −n 张, 已缩小, 失败后清空历史/丢弃历史截图, 312 字), compactionLabel, screenLabel, droppedImages, isSummaryLog, isFailedLog, latestCommentLog, latestCompactionLog, recentRounds, latencySeries, cacheSeries (oldest first, summaries excluded), formatBytes, formatMegabytes ("3.1"), formatCacheUsage, cachePercent, formatCount ("5,612"), formatDuration, formatSecondsValue ("2.41"), formatLogTime, formatClock ("14:32:08"), formatMonthDay, rangeHint(range, unit, scale), formatSpan(min,max,unit) ("14–28 秒"), countdownState, formatCountdown(s)→{value,unit,spoken}, roundForDisplay, parseScaledInput, displayNumber, countText, isCssColor, parsePalette, paletteColor(palette, i), type Tone. constants.ts — PageId, SettingsPageId, PAGES (title/description/icon/group), pageMeta, pageFromHash, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDERS, SUMMARY_PLACEHOLDER, UNIMPLEMENTED_HINTS, UNIMPLEMENTED_PLACEHOLDERS, isMac, LOG_PAGE_SIZE=100.
checks:
npm run typecheck: passes (tsc renderer + electron + tests, no errors).
npx vitest run: Test Files 28 passed (28), Tests 389 passed (389) — incl. new test/settingsFormat.test.ts (22) and test/previewData.test.ts (5).
npm run build: clean + typecheck + build:electron + vite build OK ("✓ built in 1.95s"; CSS 41 kB, JS 205 kB; icons emitted as assets).
Playwright behaviour checks (dev server on 5181, stopped afterwards): popover Enter→focus on active profile, Escape closes + focus back on trigger, create profile via Enter, switch profile saves draft first (edited 角色名 survived a round-trip), outside click closes, nav + hash routing + document.title, unknown hash → 总览, 生成一次 busy → 第 38 轮 + log badge 40, pause/start → start-delay coral track, dirty dots (角色与称呼 + 运行节奏), Ctrl+S saves, 还原 reverts, no horizontal overflow at 940×660, overlay keeps danmaku-move animation under reduced motion with transparent body, Electron UA without bridge shows BRIDGE_MISSING_MESSAGE.
openIssues:
- Placeholders: the 8 pages render an EmptyState 「这一页正在重做」; page agents replace their bodies (and fill their CSS file). Gallery/harness used for visual checks were temporary and deleted.
- Mapping for page agents copying mockup CSS: mockup pink accent → accent tokens; --pink → --coral (deco) / --coral-text (text); mockup cyan chips/callouts/tile icons → accent / Callout tone="info" (or coral where a secondary hue is wanted); input edges use --field-border (Fluent-style darker bottom edge for 3:1) instead of a uniform --line-strong border.
- Behaviour changes vs the old UI (intentional, per spec): 清空日志 now confirms (window.confirm in controller.clearLogs); the connection-test result is no longer a global banner — it is controller.connection for the Model page aside; actionError banner title 「操作失败：」.
- DanmakuStage was added as an extra shared component (both the overview stage and the appearance preview need it); OverlayApp.tsx itself was not modified — the Danmaku task can switch it to DanmakuText/.danmaku-text (same CSS rule as .danmaku-line already).
- previewData.ts is statically imported by api.ts, so it ships in the production bundle (~10 kB, never executed in Electron because window.danmaku exists); api() is synchronous so a dynamic import was not used.
- Demo ?demo=delay has cycles 0 and no live stats (a fresh launch) but keeps persisted logs; ?demo=error uses state "error" with a 413 lastError and a learned 16 MiB requestLimitBytes.
- Old createConfigProfile default name in the mock now uses "<active name> 副本" (identical to before in non-demo mode).
